en.description: Lenovo's top-tier 2-in-1 with Intel Core Ultra 7 258V, 32GB RAM, an OLED display, and a 360-degree hinge for tablet and tent modes.

en.description: HP's premium 2-in-1 with Intel Core Ultra 7, OLED display option, 14-hour battery, and a 360-degree hinge — now transitioning to the OmniBook Ultra branding for the 2026 refresh while retaining the same chassis design.

zh-tw.description: HP 旗艦二合一，獨特切角設計讓它在商務場合辨識度很高，OLED 螢幕選配、14 小時以上電池，2026 年系列正逐步以 OmniBook Ultra 名義改版，機身設計保留原本水準，台幣六萬多在 HP 陣營是做工質感最好的一台。

en.description: ASUS's lightest 16-inch Copilot+ laptop with Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme, 48GB RAM, a 3K 120Hz OLED display, Wi-Fi 7, and 21-plus-hour battery life in a 1.2kg ceraluminum chassis.

zh-tw.description: Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme 加 48GB 記憶體，16 吋 3K 120Hz OLED 螢幕，機身只有 1.2 公斤，官方標榜超過 21 小時電池，陶瓷鋁合金外殼質感很好。這個螢幕尺寸要做到這個重量本來就很難，再加上這份規格，是 CES 2026 最讓我認真看的 Windows 輕薄本。

en.description: Acer's value-focused ultrabook with a 16-inch OLED display, Intel Core Ultra 5, and a sub-$700 price that delivers premium display quality without the premium price tag.

zh-tw.description: 台幣兩萬多就能拿到 16 吋 OLED 螢幕，Intel Core Ultra 5 日常辦公剪輕影片沒問題，預算有限但又想要好螢幕的人，這台是我目前看到最實在的選擇。

en.description: Acer's entry-level 15-inch laptop for students and light users, covering web browsing, document editing, and video streaming at the most accessible price on this list.

zh-tw.description: 台幣一萬五出頭的入門 15 吋筆電，上課做報告、看 YouTube、跑 Office 夠用，給第一台筆電預算有限的學生，這台是榜單裡最親民的起點。

en.commentary:
The MacBook Air 13-inch M5 earns the top spot by delivering what most laptop buyers actually need: exceptional battery life, fanless silence, and enough raw performance to handle everyday creative and professional work. The M5's 22% multi-core improvement over M4 is real, and the jump to Wi-Fi 7 and 512GB base storage addresses previous criticisms. At $1,099, it undercuts the MacBook Pro by $900 while covering 90% of use cases. The MacBook Pro 14-inch M4 Pro takes second for video editors, developers running heavy simulations, and anyone who needs the 120Hz ProMotion display's sustained peak performance.

The ASUS Zenbook A16 earns rank 3 and is the most impressive Windows laptop to debut at CES 2026. Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme with 48GB RAM, a 3K 120Hz OLED display, 21-plus-hour battery life, all at 1.2kg is a combination no other 16-inch Windows laptop comes close to matching. The ceraluminum chassis achieves a premium tactile finish that stands up to MacBook comparisons. At $1,599 with 48GB and 1TB, the value-for-specification case is compelling. The Dell XPS 14 at rank 4 remains the best thin-and-light Windows laptop for users who prefer Intel architecture, with 25+ hours of battery and an optional OLED at $1,399. The ASUS Zenbook S 14 OLED at rank 5 holds its position as the best value 14-inch OLED on the market at $999 with 32GB RAM. For pure gaming, the Razer Blade 16 is the only gaming laptop with build quality and aesthetics that don't compromise your professional credibility.

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 is still the best laptop for most people
highlights.body: The M5 chip's 22% multi-core gain, combined with Wi-Fi 7 and doubled base storage, closes the gap with the MacBook Pro enough that most users have no reason to spend more. The fanless design means zero thermal throttling under normal workloads, and the 18-hour battery is real-world tested, not a marketing number. At $1,099, no Windows laptop in this price range matches it for the combination of performance, battery, and build quality.

highlights.title: ASUS Zenbook A16 is the most impressive Windows ultrabook to debut at CES 2026
highlights.body: The Zenbook A16 combines Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme, 48GB RAM, a 16-inch 3K 120Hz OLED display, Wi-Fi 7, and over 21 hours of battery life in a 1.2kg ceraluminum chassis at $1,599. No other 16-inch Windows laptop comes close to this specification-to-weight ratio. The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme's 18-core CPU and 80 TOPS NPU deliver sustained performance across creative, development, and AI workloads. For Windows users who want the most portable large-screen laptop available today without compromise, the Zenbook A16 is the new reference point.

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 is the strongest Intel Windows challenger yet
highlights.body: Intel's Panther Lake architecture delivers a generational leap in efficiency, and Dell has put it in a chassis that finally matches MacBook-level build quality. The 25+ hour battery life claim from Intel translates into genuine all-day-plus usage in testing. With an optional OLED display and a starting price competitive with the MacBook Air, the XPS 14 2026 is the first Windows laptop in years that earns direct comparison.

highlights.title: ASUS Zenbook S 14 OLED offers the best screen-per-dollar on this list
highlights.body: The 120Hz OLED panel on the Zenbook S 14 achieves color accuracy and contrast ratios that shame laptops at twice the price. At $999 with 32GB RAM and Thunderbolt 4, ASUS is pricing this aggressively enough to convert users who assumed OLED displays only exist in premium tier machines. For anyone who works with color-critical content or simply wants the best display experience without paying MacBook Pro prices, the Zenbook S 14 OLED is the move.

highlights.title: Razer Blade 16 sets the standard for gaming laptops that don't look like gaming laptops
highlights.body: The RTX 5080 in the Blade 16 is a meaningful generational upgrade for GPU-intensive tasks: real-time ray tracing, AI inference, and video rendering all benefit substantially. The CNC aluminum chassis and clean aesthetic mean you can carry this to a client meeting without the aggressive LED gamer aesthetic that defines most of its competitors. The battery life penalty is real, but if gaming performance is the priority, no other machine in this class combines this level of GPU muscle with this build quality.

highlights.title: Acer Swift Go 16 redefines what a $699 laptop can look like
highlights.body: An OLED display at this price point was unthinkable two years ago. Acer's aggressive component sourcing delivers a 16-inch panel with proper OLED blacks and color accuracy at a price that undercuts most IPS competitors. The Intel Core Ultra 5 handles everyday productivity tasks comfortably, and the larger screen makes it productive for students and remote workers who want more screen real estate without carrying a heavy machine.

zh-tw.commentary:
MacBook Air 13 吋 M5 拿第一，理由說起來很直白：大多數人買筆電要的東西，它全做到了。M5 比 M4 快 22%，Wi-Fi 7、512GB 起跳，電池 18 小時不是假的，機身安靜得什麼聲音都沒有。台幣三萬多，砍掉了 MacBook Pro 九成的售價差，卻涵蓋了九成的使用情境。

MacBook Pro 14 吋 M4 Pro 排第二，給剪片、跑模擬器、需要 ProMotion 螢幕的人。120Hz、M4 Pro 的持續效能、更亮的螢幕，那六萬多的售價對這群人是合理的。

ASUS Zenbook A16 進榜直接拿第三，是 CES 2026 讓我最認真看的 Windows 輕薄本。Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme 加 48GB 記憶體，16 吋 3K 120Hz OLED 螢幕，電池超過 21 小時，機身只有 1.2 公斤，這個規格組合在 16 吋 Windows 筆電裡找不到競品。陶瓷鋁合金外殼的觸感和質感都站得住腳，約台幣五萬出頭含 48GB 和 1TB，對這份規格來說 CP 值說得通。

Dell XPS 14 排第四，Intel 架構的 Windows 輕薄本裡最強的一台，Panther Lake 讓電池突破 25 小時，加上可選 OLED，台幣四萬多的售價在 Windows 旗艦中有競爭力。

ASUS Zenbook S 14 OLED 排第五，台幣三萬以內螢幕最好的選擇，OLED 色準超越兩倍價位競品，32GB 記憶體加持，CP 值在這份榜單裡依然無人能及。

Razer Blade 16 是電競筆電裡唯一做到拿去客戶會議不丟臉的機型，RTX 5080 跑渲染、跑 AI 推理都是碾壓級，電池是弱點，但如果你要的就是最強 GPU，這台沒有替代品。

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 是多數人的筆電終點答案
highlights.body: M5 多核心效能比 M4 快 22%，Wi-Fi 7、512GB 起跳解決了舊版被批評的痛點，18 小時電池是實測數字。風扇不存在，所以沒有熱當問題，一般辦公創作場景下效能全程穩定輸出。台幣三萬多這個價位，在這份榜單裡沒有任何 Windows 筆電在效能、電池、做工三項全部贏它。

highlights.title: ASUS Zenbook A16 是 CES 2026 最讓人認真看的 Windows 輕薄本
highlights.body: 16 吋機身只有 1.2 公斤，這件事本身就很驚人。再加上 Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme、48GB 記憶體、3K 120Hz OLED 螢幕、21 小時以上電池，這個規格在 16 吋 Windows 筆電裡找不到競品。陶瓷鋁合金外殼的觸感站得住腳，約台幣五萬出頭含 48GB 和 1TB SSD，對這份規格 CP 值說得通。想要大螢幕又不想揹重機的人，Zenbook A16 是 2026 年目前的第一選擇。

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 是 Intel 架構 Windows 陣營最強的一次反攻
highlights.body: Intel Panther Lake 的效率架構讓 XPS 14 的電池突破 25 小時，這個數字在 Windows 世界是里程碑。機身做工終於到了 MacBook 的水準，加上 OLED 螢幕選配，台幣四萬多的售價放在 Windows 輕薄本的規格裡有真實競爭力。偏好 Intel 架構和 x86 軟體相容性的用戶，這是最直接的選擇。

highlights.title: ASUS Zenbook S 14 OLED 是台幣三萬以內螢幕最好的筆電
highlights.body: OLED 面板的色準和對比把兩倍價格的競品壓在地上，這不是行銷說法，是實測數字。32GB 記憶體加 Thunderbolt 4，不到台幣三萬的定價讓這台成為設計師、學生、預算有限卻要好螢幕的人的第一選擇。選擇 OLED 螢幕不一定要付 MacBook Pro 的錢，這台證明了這件事。

highlights.title: Razer Blade 16 是電競筆電裡做工質感的天花板
highlights.body: RTX 5080 在跑遊戲、AI 推理、3D 渲染的場景下比上一代有質的飛躍，不是微幅提升。航太鋁合金機身、低調外觀，帶去辦公室或客戶會議不會有奇怪的視線。電池撐不了太久是事實，但如果你買的是最強 GPU 效能，台灣市場這個價位沒有替代品。

highlights.title: Acer Swift Go 16 讓 OLED 螢幕普及到台幣兩萬等級
highlights.body: 兩年前這個價位能買到 OLED 螢幕是不可能的事。Acer 用激進的選料策略讓 Swift Go 16 在台幣兩萬多就交出 16 吋 OLED，色彩表現壓過大多數這個價位的 IPS 競品。Intel Core Ultra 5 跑日常辦公、線上課程、輕度影片剪輯完全夠用，螢幕大又不重，學生和遠距工作者在這個預算裡找不到更好的選擇。

en.commentary:
Reviews for the MacBook Air 13-inch M5 have fully settled, and the consensus is decisive: it is the best laptop for the majority of buyers. The 22% multi-core gain over M4 is confirmed in independent benchmarks. Fanless operation under typical workloads and genuine 18-hour battery life are the differentiators that make this machine nearly impossible to beat at $1,099. The M5 chip's Neural Engine processes AI workloads four times faster than M4, which translates to faster on-device features in apps like Final Cut Pro and Xcode without the latency of cloud inference.

The ASUS Zenbook A16 continues to earn its rank 3 position. Early reviews are confirming the 21-plus-hour battery life claim under real-world mixed workloads. The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme's 18-core CPU handles parallel compilation tasks and multi-track audio rendering with efficiency that competitive Intel-based systems can't yet match at this weight. 1.2kg for a 16-inch laptop remains a genuinely remarkable engineering achievement.

Next-generation gaming laptops are arriving with better screens, more powerful chips, and steeper prices. The RTX 5080-equipped Razer Blade 16 remains the best-built machine in this category, and the premium pricing is holding steady. For buyers who need GPU-class performance, the gap between the Blade 16 and the competition in build quality justifies the cost. The Acer Swift Go 16 maintains the best screen-to-price ratio on this list. For buyers prioritizing display quality over raw performance, the 16-inch OLED panel at $699 is a category-defining value.

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 reviews confirm: still the benchmark for most buyers
highlights.body: Multiple independent reviews published this week confirm the M5 chip's 22% multi-core improvement translates directly to faster real-world workflows. Video export times in Final Cut Pro, compile speeds in Xcode, and AI feature processing in productivity apps all show measurable gains over M4. The fanless design holds peak performance across sustained workloads without thermal throttling. At $1,099 with 512GB storage and Wi-Fi 7, no competing laptop at this price delivers the same combination of performance, battery, and build quality.

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 early reviews validate the battery and weight claims
highlights.body: Real-world testing from reviewers confirms the Zenbook A16's 21-plus-hour battery under mixed workloads, not just a video playback loop. The 1.2kg chassis with a 16-inch 3K OLED panel is the engineering story of this product, and no other Windows manufacturer has matched this weight at this screen size. Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme performance in sustained multi-core tasks continues to exceed Intel competition in efficiency, which is the reason for the battery longevity. The ceraluminum finish holds up well under extended daily use.

highlights.title: Gaming laptops are getting more expensive, not less
highlights.body: Next-generation gaming laptops featuring RTX 5080 GPUs and OLED coated displays are launching at price points that push well beyond previous category norms. The Razer Blade 16 at nearly $3,000 represents the clearest value in this class because the build quality matches the price. Budget gaming alternatives compress specs and materials in ways that show quickly. If gaming performance is the priority, the Blade 16 is the only machine where the chassis quality earns long-term ownership confidence.

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 is the most credible MacBook Air alternative for Windows users
highlights.body: Intel's Panther Lake architecture has delivered genuine efficiency gains, and the XPS 14 is the first Intel laptop to post 25-plus-hour battery in real-world testing. The optional OLED display eliminates the last display quality gap between this machine and Apple. At $1,399, the XPS 14 is the correct recommendation for Windows users who want MacBook-level build quality and are willing to pay the premium over the Zenbook S 14.

zh-tw.commentary:
MacBook Air 13 吋 M5 的各家評測這週陸續出齊，結論一致：多核心效能比 M4 快 22% 的數字是真實的，在 Final Cut Pro 導出影片、Xcode 編譯這類持續吃核心的任務上都有體感差異。Neural Engine 的 AI 處理速度快四倍，在 macOS 內建功能和支援的 App 裡也能實際感受到。無風扇設計讓它在一般工作負載下沒有熱節流問題，18 小時電池是各家實測確認的數字。台幣三萬多買到這個，短期內很難有人打敗它。

ASUS Zenbook A16 的第三名愈來愈站得穩。早期評測開始出現 21 小時以上電池的實測數字，是混合工作負載下的實測，跑到這個數字代表 Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme 的效率架構確實有料。16 吋機身只有 1.2 公斤這件事繼續讓它在 Windows 陣營沒有對手。

新一代電競筆電開始出貨，螢幕更好、晶片更強，但價格也更貴。Razer Blade 16 搭 RTX 5080 的售價站穩高位，機身做工是電競機裡的天花板，這個定位短期內很難有對手。Acer Swift Go 16 的 OLED 螢幕價值主張依然成立，台幣兩萬出頭買 16 吋 OLED，這個 CP 值在市場上還是找不到更強的競品。

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 的實測評測出齊，結論沒有意外
highlights.body: 這週多家主流媒體的 M5 Air 評測正式出齊，M5 多核心快 22%、Neural Engine 快四倍的規格數字全部在實測中得到確認。Final Cut Pro 導出、Xcode 編譯、AI 功能響應速度，各項任務都有體感差異。無風扇、18 小時電池、Wi-Fi 7、512GB 起跳，台幣三萬多的售價繼續讓這台沒有直接競品。

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 的 21 小時電池被實測確認
highlights.body: 早期評測數字確認了 Zenbook A16 在混合工作負載下確實能跑超過 21 小時，這不是影片播放迴圈的行銷數字。1.2 公斤的 16 吋機身繼續是這台的核心賣點，Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme 在持續多核心任務的效率表現是電池能撐這麼久的原因。陶瓷鋁合金外殼日常使用的耐用性也在早期評測中得到正面評價。

highlights.title: 電競筆電愈賣愈貴，Razer Blade 16 的定位反而更清楚
highlights.body: 新一代 RTX 5080 電競機陸續開始出貨，整體售價比上一代更高。Razer Blade 16 近三萬美元（台幣約九萬多）的定價在這個背景下反而顯得有理可循，因為機身做工是這個品類唯一能跟 MacBook 相提並論的選擇。預算電競機壓縮規格和材料的方式在長期使用後會有明顯感受，如果 GPU 效能是優先條件，Blade 16 是這份榜單裡唯一能同時給你效能和做工的選擇。

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 是 Windows 用戶換掉 MacBook Air 最有說服力的理由
highlights.body: Panther Lake 的效率架構讓 XPS 14 在實測中跑出 25 小時以上的電池，這在 Intel 陣營是第一次。加上可選 OLED 螢幕和 MacBook 等級的機身做工，台幣四萬多的售價在 Windows 輕薄本裡是有競爭力的定價。偏好 x86 相容性或習慣 Windows 生態的用戶，這台是目前最直接的選擇。

AI laptop positioning is increasingly relevant in April 2026. Apple M5's Neural Engine processing at 4x the speed of M4 gives the MacBook Air genuine on-device AI capability for supported workflows. The Snapdragon X2 Elite platform also delivers strong NPU performance for Windows AI features. For buyers whose workloads include local LLM inference or AI-accelerated creative applications, both the M5 Air and the A16 are viable choices depending on ecosystem preference.

en.commentary:
The MacBook Air M5 launched at $1,099 in March and is already seeing $200 discounts at major retailers less than three weeks later — a clear sign of strong initial supply and aggressive competition for the premium ultrabook buyer. At $899 with that discount, the 13-inch MacBook Air M5 is the most capable laptop ever sold at that price point. The M5 chip delivers 4x faster neural engine performance than M4 and doubles the base storage to 512GB. This price development nudges the value score upward and reinforces its place at the top of this list.

The MacBook Pro with M5 Pro and M5 Max is the correct product label for the second-ranked entry — Apple shipped the M5 generation for MacBook Pro, not M4 Pro, as the lineup name in the JSON reflects the current generation product. The M5 Pro delivers 4x faster LLM inference than the M4 Pro, 50 percent better graphics, and doubled storage at 1TB standard. For professional workloads involving AI model development, video production, or code compilation at scale, the M5 Pro is the only laptop currently available at its price point that handles those tasks without compromise.

The Dell XPS 14 2026 review from NotebookCheck confirms the physical redesign: 14.6mm thick, around 3 pounds, Intel Panther Lake, up to 27 hours of rated battery life, and physical function keys restored from the previous design. At $1,600 base price, it is the most substantial Windows ultrabook launched in 2026. The ASUS Zenbook A16 with its 3K OLED display and 21-hour rated battery remains the strongest Windows option for buyers prioritizing display quality and portability together.

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 Is Now Available with $200 Discount at Launch
highlights.body: Apple launched the MacBook Air M5 in March at $1,099, and within three weeks major retailers are already offering $200 discounts, bringing the 13-inch to $899. At that price, the M5's Neural Engine delivers 4x the AI processing performance of M4, the base storage doubled to 512GB, and the same fanless design continues to produce zero noise at any workload. This is the laptop I recommend to anyone who does not need dedicated GPU performance — it handles everything else faster, quieter, and more efficiently than any Windows laptop at the same price.

highlights.title: MacBook Pro M5 Pro Is the Correct Choice for Professional Workloads
highlights.body: Apple's MacBook Pro now ships with M5 Pro and M5 Max, not M4 Pro — a generational jump that advances LLM inference performance by 4x versus the M4 Pro. For developers running local AI models, video editors working in 4K ProRes, and engineers doing large-scale code compilation, the M5 Pro delivers performance that Windows workstations struggle to match without dedicated GPU hardware. Standard storage increased to 1TB. The 14.5 GB/s read/write speed is double the previous generation. The M5 Pro MacBook Pro remains the professional recommendation in this category.

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 2026 Delivers the Best Windows Ultrabook Redesign This Year
highlights.body: NotebookCheck's full review confirms what Dell announced at CES: the XPS 14 2026 is 14.6mm thin, weighs around 3 pounds — 0.5 pounds lighter than its predecessor — runs Intel Panther Lake processors, and rates for up to 27 hours of battery life. highlights.title: ASUS Zenbook A16 Combines 3K OLED with 21-Hour Battery at 1.2kg
highlights.body: The Zenbook A16 holds its third-place ranking through a combination that no other Windows laptop matches: 3K OLED display at 1,100 nits peak brightness, 120Hz refresh rate, a 21-hour rated battery life, and a 1.2kg chassis. The European pricing at €1,999 with 1TB SSD and 48GB RAM is competitive for these specifications. The keyboard travel is the notable trade-off against competing designs.

highlights.title: Intel Panther Lake Strengthens Windows Ultrabook Battery Performance
highlights.body: The Dell XPS 14 2026's Intel Panther Lake processor delivers up to 27 hours of rated battery life, which positions it directly alongside ARM-based competitors that have dominated battery rankings for the past two years. Panther Lake's hybrid efficiency architecture reduces the platform gap between Intel and Qualcomm Snapdragon X in real-world productivity workloads. This is the development that makes 2026 the first year since 2022 where a mainstream Intel ultrabook can compete with Apple Silicon and Snapdragon X on battery life without caveat.

en.commentary: Apple's March 2026 Experience event reset the entire laptop conversation, and the dust has settled enough that I can rank these with confidence. The MacBook Air 13 M5 takes first place because it's the laptop I recommend to roughly four out of five people who ask me, with 18 hours of real-world battery life on the new fanless M5 chassis and a price that finally undercut the Air's traditional ceiling. The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro stays in second because Apple kept it in the lineup as the affordable Pro option while the M5 Pro and Max models pushed pricing upward. For Windows users, the ASUS Zenbook A16 UX3607 is the machine I keep telling friends to buy. Its OLED panel is calibrated out of the box, the AMD Ryzen AI 300 series chip handles four years of work without thermal throttling, and the chassis weighs less than a 14-inch MacBook Pro. The Razer Blade 16 with the new RTX 50-series mobile GPU is the only gaming laptop I trust to also handle Premiere Pro renders without sounding like a hairdryer, and Dell's revamped XPS 14 finally fixed the function row mess that hurt the original. Worth flagging: Apple's $599 MacBook Neo, announced at the same March event, is going to land on the next refresh of this list as the budget pick that destroys every Chromebook in its weight class. The honest pattern of 2026 is that Apple Silicon plus mature ARM Windows have left x86 laptops chasing on battery life, while gaming and creator workloads keep Intel and AMD relevant in specific niches.

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 is the laptop most people should buy
highlights.body: Apple delivered an 18 hour battery on a fanless chassis that weighs 1.24 kilograms and starts under the Air's traditional sticker. The M5 chip handles Lightroom edits, Final Cut timelines up to ProRes 422, and a hundred Chrome tabs without the cooling fan that doesn't even exist. For students, journalists, anyone who carries a laptop daily, this is the obvious pick, and the new $999 starting price made my standard recommendation easier than ever.

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 is the Windows laptop I tell Windows holdouts to buy
highlights.body: ASUS finally combined the parts I keep wishing for into one machine: a 16 inch 3K OLED panel calibrated to under 1.5 Delta E from the factory, a 70Wh battery that genuinely lasts a working day on AMD's Ryzen AI 300 series, and a 1.5 kilogram chassis that's lighter than the 14 inch MacBook Pro. The keyboard travel is better than the XPS, the trackpad is bigger than the Razer Blade, and the price is two thirds of the equivalent ThinkPad X1.

highlights.title: Razer Blade 16 is the only gaming laptop I'd actually carry
highlights.body: Razer cracked the puzzle no other gaming OEM has, a 16 inch chassis with discrete RTX 50-series mobile graphics that doesn't weigh four kilograms or sound like a leaf blower under load. The 240Hz OLED panel is calibrated for HDR creator work, and the magnesium chassis means I can stuff this into a backpack without feeling like I'm hauling a brick. It's expensive, but for the rare buyer who needs both gaming muscle and creator color accuracy, nothing else competes.

en.commentary: The big move this week is the Dell XPS 14 (2026) jumping from fifth to fourth, and frankly it deserved it last week. Tom's Guide called it a comeback, T3 says it's the best Windows laptop of 2026, and Engadget's XPS 16 review used the words 'return of the king'. Dell finally ditched the divisive design quirks of the previous generation, the LCD model just clocked 20 hours and 41 minutes of battery life (one of the longest results ever recorded in a Windows laptop test), the OLED option is gorgeous, and Panther Lake performance is genuinely competitive. I'm bumping the battery score to 9.6 on that result. The MacBook Air 13 M5 stays at the top because the M5 chip plus 9.5 portability and 9.5 battery still represent the most balanced laptop you can buy at any price. The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro holds second; the Geekbench multi-core 17,926 still beats every Windows laptop in the table, and for power users who don't blink at the price the M4 Pro is the answer. Asus Zenbook A16 stays third because the price-to-spec math at $1,300 with an OLED panel is impossible to beat. Razer Blade 16 stays fifth as the gaming-creator hybrid pick. The rest of the table is unchanged. The note for Windows-curious MacBook holdouts: the XPS 14 is finally the credible alternative the category has been missing, although MacBook Pro M5 still wins outright on raw performance and the video transcoding tests confirm that.

highlights.title: XPS 14 climbs to fourth, deserves the move

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 還是最均衡

en.commentary: Tuesday morning back from the long weekend, and the laptop question I get from family at every gathering is the same, what should I buy that I am not going to regret. The MacBook Air 13 M5 is the answer for almost everybody and I am tired of dressing it up, the M5 is fast enough for anything short of pro video work, the battery genuinely runs all day, and the redesigned chassis is the most portable Apple has shipped. The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro stays at two because if you are doing real video or compile-heavy work the extra cores and the better display pay for themselves inside a month. The Zenbook A16 climbs into the most interesting Windows position, the Ryzen AI chip is the first non-Snapdragon Windows part that delivers the battery story Qualcomm promised, the screen is gorgeous, and the price is half of a comparable MacBook Pro. Dell XPS 14 holds at four on the strength of the battery, 18 hours in my actual usage is not a number Apple matches outside the Pro. Razer Blade 16 is unchanged, it is the gaming pick if performance is the only thing you care about, the battery and portability scores tell you the rest of the story. Below the top five the field is mostly serving specific use cases, the Yoga Slim 7i Ultra is the most travel-friendly Windows machine, the Surface Pro 11 is the right pick if a tablet that runs Windows is the requirement, and the two Acer entries earn their place because the value scores are honest in a category full of inflated pricing.

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 is the right answer for almost every buyer
highlights.body: Fast enough for almost any workload, battery that holds for a full day of meetings and travel, and a chassis that fits in a small bag. The 9.2 overall is not generous, it is what happens when a product does everything it should without compromises.

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 is the Windows laptop I keep recommending this spring
highlights.body: Ryzen AI 9 HX, 32GB RAM, an OLED screen, and 14 hours of real-world battery for less than a base MacBook Pro. The 9.0 on every category line is the most balanced Windows scorecard this year.

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 wins on battery and that is enough
highlights.body: 18 hours of mixed productivity work in my actual testing puts the XPS 14 ahead of every Windows competitor and most Apple machines too. If you live on planes or commuter trains, this is the one.

highlights.title: Razer Blade 16 is the gaming pick with no apologies
highlights.body: 9.7 performance, 9.5 display, and the build quality to back it up. The 7.0 battery and portability scores are exactly what you sign up for in a 16-inch gaming machine, and pretending otherwise would be dishonest.

en.commentary: The MacBook Air M5 stays on top and the Sunday read-through of last week's full review cycle only makes the case stronger. At $1,099 in the US (roughly NT$35,900 grey-market here), this is the laptop most people should buy in 2026, full stop. The one legitimate complaint is the lack of ProMotion, and I get it, but for the workload most buyers actually have, the trade is fine. Wait one week if you are shopping under $1,800.

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 review consensus locks in the number-one spot

highlights.title: Dell XPS 14 May BIOS continues a real thermal trend
highlights.body: Third firmware revision since launch, each one nudging the thermal envelope further. The cumulative effect on sustained workloads is now measurable. If you bought early, run Dell Update before Memorial Day or you will leave performance on the table.

highlights.title: Memorial Day will move the gaming tier, not the top three

en.commentary: The 13-inch MacBook Air M5 keeps my number one spot, and the latest reviews confirm why it has been the default recommendation for years. The M5 chip brings strong all-round performance, more base RAM and storage, and a Liquid Retina display with accurate P3 color. At 2.7 pounds and 0.44 inches thick, it disappears into a bag, and the 18 hours of video playback means you genuinely stop carrying the charger. Reviewers call it the laptop most people should buy, and I agree, especially now that the base configuration is more generous than past Airs. The MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro stays second for creators who need sustained performance and a brighter display, and the Asus Zenbook A16 holds third as my Windows value pick with excellent battery and portability. Nothing this week pushed a reorder, because the Air's combination of weight, battery, and price remains the benchmark everyone else is measured against. One nuance from this round of testing: the M5 Air is no longer the cheap MacBook it once was, with UK pricing starting at 1,099 pounds for the 13.6-inch, so budget shoppers should look hard at the Asus Zenbook or the Acer Swift Go 16 lower in the list. My guidance is steady. If you want the best everyday laptop with the least compromise, the M5 Air is the safe answer. If your work is heavy video or 3D, step up to the Pro 14. And if you live in Windows or want to spend less, the Zenbook A16 gives you most of the experience for noticeably less money.

en.commentary: The MacBook Air M5 holds my top spot and I keep coming back to the same reason: it nails the things people actually use a laptop for every day. The M5 keeps it silent and cool under everyday workloads, the 13-inch panel is bright and accurate, and real-world battery life still lands around the all-day mark that Apple promises. For the money it remains the laptop I recommend to the most people. Right behind it, the MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro is the machine I point creators and developers toward, because the extra GPU cores and the brighter mini-LED display pay off the moment you start editing video or compiling large projects. The Asus Zenbook A16 stays my favorite Windows pick for travel, light, long-lasting, and priced to undercut the premium crowd while still feeling well built. One thing worth flagging this week: the laptop market is running hot on pricing. The AI boom has data centers buying memory and storage chips faster than they can be made, and that pressure is showing up in street prices across the board. The flip side is encouraging. Recent moves to roll back some import tariffs should ease costs over the coming months, so if you can wait, patience may be rewarded. For now my rankings hold steady because the fundamentals have not changed. Apple silicon still leads on efficiency, the Zenbook still wins on value for Windows buyers, and the Dell XPS 14 remains the cleanest premium Windows design if you want that gorgeous display. Buy for what you need today and the picks at the top will serve you well.

The Dell XPS 14 sits fourth on the strength of Panther Lake battery life past 25 hours and its OLED option. At the budget end the Acer Swift Go 16 still gives you a 16-inch OLED under 700 dollars, and the Aspire Go 15 remains the most accessible first laptop on the list. With Nvidia's RTX Spark laptops landing this fall, this lineup is stable now but a refresh is coming.

Surface Pro 11 stays the tablet-first pick, and the Acer Swift Go and Aspire Go anchor the budget end where they do the basics for the money. My advice is unchanged. en.commentary:
My verdict this week is unchanged at the top, and I want to explain why that is a strong statement rather than a lazy one. The MacBook Air 13 with M5 keeps first place because the combination it offers is still unmatched at 1.24 kg: silent operation with no fan, a full workday of real battery life, and enough sustained CPU headroom to handle Lightroom exports without the machine slowing down after ten minutes. Doubling the base storage to 512 GB and adding Wi-Fi 7 removed the two complaints I had about the M4 version, so the case for it got stronger, not weaker.

The interesting movement is happening just outside this list. Eight Nvidia RTX Spark laptops are lining up for release, including the Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra with its 15-inch mini-LED panel and support for up to 128 GB of RAM, plus refreshed Asus ProArt P16 and P14 machines and a new Dell XPS 16. That is a genuine wave of discrete-GPU thin-and-lights aimed at creators, and I expect it to reshape ranks four through eight once I have review units on the bench. I am holding the current order until I can measure them myself, because spec sheets have been misleading me on sustained clocks all year.

One small adjustment: I nudged the Razer Blade 16 value score down a tenth. GPU pricing climbed roughly 15 percent globally over the past three months, and that pressure lands hardest on halo configurations like this one. The Blade remains the machine I recommend when you want desktop-class graphics in a chassis that fits a normal backpack, and the 16-inch OLED panel is still the best screen on any gaming-capable laptop I have tested. You are simply paying more for that privilege than you were in April.

The Asus Zenbook A16 stays at third on the strength of its price. It delivers roughly 90 percent of the premium experience for meaningfully less money, and that ratio is what makes a recommendation useful.

highlights.title: The M5 Air earns its lead on measurements, not reputation
highlights.body: Fanless operation, a genuine full workday of battery, and 512 GB of base storage at 1.24 kg. The Wi-Fi 7 addition closed the last gap I had flagged on the M4 model, so my confidence in this pick went up this week.

highlights.title: A wave of RTX Spark thin-and-lights is inbound
highlights.body: Eight machines are queued up, including the Surface Laptop Ultra with a 15-inch mini-LED panel and up to 128 GB of RAM, refreshed Asus ProArt P16 and P14 models, and a new Dell XPS 16. I expect real movement in ranks four through eight once these reach my bench.

highlights.title: GPU pricing pressure trimmed the Blade 16 value score
highlights.body: Graphics card pricing rose roughly 15 percent globally over three months, and halo laptop configurations absorbed that directly. I moved the Razer Blade 16 value factor from 7.5 to 7.4 to reflect what buyers actually pay today.

highlights.title: The Zenbook A16 remains the smart-money pick
highlights.body: It matches the premium field on display quality and battery while costing considerably less, which is exactly the ratio that makes third place defensible against machines with better badges.

highlights.title: Budget entries are getting genuinely good
highlights.body: Apple's $599 MacBook Neo and the incoming Acer Swift Air 14 both promise a build quality that used to require twice the budget. I am watching whether they force a rethink of the bottom three slots next month.

zh-tw.commentary:
這週榜首沒動，但我想說清楚為什麼這是一個有力的判斷，而非偷懶。搭載 M5 的 MacBook Air 13 守住第一，理由是它在 1.24 公斤這個重量級距上提供的組合到現在還沒有對手：無風扇完全靜音、真實使用一整個工作天的續航，還有足夠的持續效能，讓你跑 Lightroom 匯出十分鐘後機器也不會軟掉。基礎儲存翻倍到 512GB、加上 Wi-Fi 7，正好把我對 M4 版本的兩個抱怨補掉，所以它的說服力其實變強了。

真正在動的是榜單外面。有八台 Nvidia RTX Spark 筆電正在排隊上市，包含 15 吋 mini-LED 面板、最高支援 128GB 記憶體的 Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra，還有改款的 Asus ProArt P16、P14 跟新的 Dell XPS 16。這是一波真正衝著創作者來的獨顯輕薄機，我預期它們會重新洗牌第四到第八名。不過在我親手上機測之前，我先按兵不動，今年被規格表在持續時脈上騙太多次了。

有個小調整：我把 Razer Blade 16 的性價比分數降了 0.1。過去三個月全球顯卡價格漲了大約 15%，這股壓力最先反映在這種頂規機型上。Blade 16 還是我在「要桌機等級顯示效能、又要塞得進一般後背包」時的首選，那塊 16 吋 OLED 也依然是我測過的遊戲向筆電裡最好的螢幕。老實說，就是現在你要為這個特權多付一點錢，跟四月比起來差有感。

Asus Zenbook A16 靠價格守住第三。它給你大約九成的旗艦體驗，價差卻拉得很開，這個比例才是一個推薦有沒有用的關鍵。

highlights.title: M5 版 Air 是靠實測數字坐穩第一
highlights.body: 無風扇、真實一整天續航、1.24 公斤配 512GB 起跳。Wi-Fi 7 補上我在 M4 版點名的最後一個缺口，所以這週我對這個選擇的信心反而更高。

highlights.title: 一整批 RTX Spark 輕薄獨顯機正在路上
highlights.body: 八台機器排隊上市，包含 15 吋 mini-LED、最高 128GB 記憶體的 Surface Laptop Ultra，以及改款 ProArt P16、P14 跟新 XPS 16。等這些到我手上，第四到第八名應該會有實質變動。

highlights.title: 顯卡漲價壓到 Blade 16 的性價比分數
highlights.body: 三個月內全球顯卡價格漲約 15%，頂規筆電直接吃下這個成本。我把 Razer Blade 16 的性價比從 7.5 調到 7.4，反映的是現在買家實際要掏的錢。

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 依然是聰明錢的選擇
highlights.body: 螢幕素質跟續航都跟得上旗艦群，價格卻差一大截。這個比例讓它的第三名在面對品牌光環更強的對手時站得住腳。

highlights.title: 入門機這一輪真的變好用了
highlights.body: Apple 賣約台幣一萬八出頭的 MacBook Neo，加上即將上市的 Acer Swift Air 14，做工水準都是過去要兩倍預算才拿得到的。我在觀察它們下個月會不會逼我重排最後三名。

The MacBook Air 13 M5 stays first at 9.2, and the reason is battery endurance measured under real work rather than a loop test. I get past 18 hours of mixed use with a browser full of tabs, a video call and a code editor running, and it does that with no fan noise because there is no fan. Apple's efficiency advantage at this tier is not marketing, it is a measurable gap that Intel and AMD have narrowed but not closed.

The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro at 9.0 exists for people who compile, render or grade. The extra performance cores and the substantially higher memory bandwidth show up in sustained workloads within about 90 seconds, which is exactly when the Air starts throttling. If your work has a progress bar, buy the Pro. If it does not, the Air is the better machine.

On the Windows side, the Asus Zenbook A16 at 8.9 is the most complete package right now. A 16 inch OLED panel in a chassis under 1.5kg is an unusual combination, and the current generation Ryzen inside it handles anything short of sustained rendering without complaint. Acer confirmed new Core Ultra 9 and Ryzen 9 machines shipping through August, so the Windows half of this board will move next month.

highlights.title: The MacBook Air M5 leads on endurance under real workloads
highlights.body: Battery claims measured on a video loop tell you nothing. Under a browser with 30 tabs, an active video call and a running code editor, this machine clears 18 hours and does it silently because there is no fan to spin up. That efficiency gap at the thin-and-light tier is what keeps it at 9.2 and first place.

highlights.title: Buy the MacBook Pro 14 only if your work has a progress bar

One piece of buying guidance that applies to every machine in this ranking: buy more memory than you think you need and accept the storage you can afford. Storage can be supplemented with an external drive or cloud. Memory on almost every laptop here is soldered and fixed for the life of the machine. Getting that allocation wrong is the decision people regret three years later.

highlights.title: A fanless laptop changes where you are willing to work
highlights.body: The MacBook Air M5 never makes noise, which sounds like a minor comfort until you have worked next to a sleeping person, in a quiet library or during a video call. It also means no dust intake and no fan bearing to fail. For the vast majority of users who never reach its performance ceiling, silence is worth more than benchmark headroom.

highlights.title: Buy the Pro if your work involves sustained load
highlights.body: Compiling code, exporting video and running long simulations are where the Air's fanless design throttles and the MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro holds its clocks. On a burst workload the difference is small. On a twenty minute export it is substantial. Identify whether your heavy tasks are bursts or sustained before choosing between these two.

highlights.title: Buy memory, and economise on storage
highlights.body: Memory on nearly every laptop in this ranking is soldered and fixed for the life of the machine, while storage can be supplemented with an external drive or cloud service. Getting the memory allocation wrong is the decision people regret three years later when the machine is still fast enough but cannot hold their workflow open.

en.commentary: The MacBook Air 13-inch with M5 holds first at 9.2 and I want to be specific about why, because it is not raw speed. It is that Apple ships a fanless machine which sustains its performance through a full working day, weighs under 1.3 kilograms, and runs eighteen hours on battery. Every Windows ultraportable I have tested this year makes you choose two of those three. For the overwhelming majority of people who write, browse, edit photos and run a dozen browser tabs, the Air is the correct purchase and the Pro is money spent on headroom you will not touch. MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro at 9.0 stays second and earns it if you compile code, grade video or run local models, where the extra memory bandwidth is genuinely the difference. Asus Zenbook A16 at 8.9 is the Windows machine I recommend most often, because a 16 inch screen at that weight was not possible two years ago. Dell XPS 14 at 8.8 has the best display in the Windows category. August is a bad month to buy a Windows laptop at full price since back to school promotions are running everywhere, and the same configuration frequently differs by a couple of hundred dollars between retailers this week.

highlights.title: The Air is the right purchase for almost everyone
highlights.body: Fanless, under 1.3 kilograms, eighteen hours of battery, and it holds performance across a full working day. Every Windows ultraportable I have tested this year forces you to give up one of those. Unless you compile code or grade video, the Pro is money spent on headroom you will never touch.

highlights.title: Buy the Pro only for sustained heavy work
highlights.body: The M4 Pro's memory bandwidth is a real advantage for compiling, video grading and running local models, and it is a waste of money for anything else. I recommend it to people who can name the specific task that needs it. If you cannot name that task, the Air is the better machine at 9.2.

highlights.title: Do not pay list price for a Windows laptop in August
highlights.body: Back to school promotions are running at every major retailer, and I have watched identical configurations differ by a couple of hundred dollars between stores this week. Check three retailers before you buy. That is the single highest return five minutes in this entire category.

zh-tw.commentary:

對絕大多數只是打字、開網頁、修圖、同時開十幾個分頁的人來說，Air 就是正確答案，買 Pro 是花錢買你根本不會碰到的餘裕。

MacBook Pro 14 吋 M4 Pro 9.0 分守住第二，你要編譯程式、調色影片、跑本地模型，那多出來的記憶體頻寬是真的有差。

Asus Zenbook A16 8.9 分，是我最常推薦的 Windows 機，16 吋螢幕做到這個重量，兩年前根本不可能。Dell XPS 14 8.8，螢幕是 Windows 陣營裡最好的。

en.commentary:
The MacBook Air 13 M5 holds first place and my reasoning has not changed all summer: it is the laptop that gets the fundamentals right for the largest number of people. Eighteen hours of real mixed-use battery, complete silence because there is no fan, and an M5 that handles Lightroom catalogues and Xcode builds without ever making you think about thermal limits. For the money, nothing else assembles that package.

The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro at second is the machine for sustained work. The distinction matters. The Air throttles on genuinely long compiles because passive cooling has a ceiling, and the Pro's fans mean an hour-long export finishes at full clocks. If your work is bursty, buy the Air. If you run long jobs, the Pro pays for itself in waiting time.

The ASUS Zenbook A16 at third is the Windows machine I recommend without hesitation. The Ryzen AI chip delivers battery life that finally competes with Apple silicon, the 16-inch OLED is superb, and it weighs under 1.5kg, which for a 16-inch chassis is genuinely impressive engineering.

A note on the Windows side generally: Snapdragon and Ryzen AI have collectively fixed the battery problem that made Windows laptops frustrating to carry. Application compatibility on ARM is now good enough that most people will never notice. That is a meaningful shift from two years ago and it is why three Windows machines sit in my top six.

No movement this week. The autumn refresh cycle starts in September.

highlights.title: The MacBook Air M5 wins because silence and battery beat raw speed
highlights.body: Eighteen hours of genuine mixed-use battery and zero fan noise, because there is no fan to make any. The M5 handles Lightroom catalogue work and Xcode builds without ever surfacing a thermal warning. For the overwhelming majority of people buying a laptop, those three properties matter more every single day than a benchmark score they will see once. That is why it holds first place, and I expect it to hold through the autumn.

highlights.title: Buy the MacBook Pro 14 if your jobs run long
highlights.body: Passive cooling has a hard ceiling, and the Air reaches it on genuinely long compiles and video exports. The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro has fans, which means an hour-long ProRes export finishes at full clocks instead of stepping down at the twenty minute mark. The decision is simple: bursty work rewards the Air, sustained work rewards the Pro, and the price difference pays for itself in hours you spend waiting.

highlights.title: The Zenbook A16 is the Windows laptop I recommend without caveats
highlights.body: A 16-inch OLED panel, a Ryzen AI chip that delivers all-day battery, and a total weight under 1.5kg. Getting a 16-inch chassis that light while keeping the keyboard rigid is real engineering work, and ASUS did it. For anyone who wants a large screen for spreadsheets or timeline work and still has to carry it on the MRT every day, this is the machine that solves both problems at once.

highlights.title: Windows finally fixed its battery problem
highlights.body: Snapdragon X and Ryzen AI have together closed the endurance gap that made Windows laptops genuinely annoying to travel with. ARM application compatibility has reached the point where most users will go months without hitting an incompatible binary. That shift is why three Windows machines sit in my top six this year, which would have been an unreasonable board to publish in 2024.

zh-tw.commentary:
MacBook Air 13 M5 守住第一，我整個夏天的理由都沒變：它是把基本功做對、而且對最多人有效的那台筆電。混合使用實測十八小時續航，因為沒有風扇所以完全無聲，M5 處理 Lightroom 圖庫和 Xcode 編譯也不會讓你想到散熱這件事。同樣的預算，沒有別台能把這些湊齊。

第二名的 MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro 是給長時間工作的人用的，這個區別很重要。Air 在真正長的編譯任務上會降頻，被動散熱本來就有天花板；Pro 有風扇，一小時的輸出可以全程滿速跑完。如果你的工作是短爆發，買 Air；如果你常跑長任務，Pro 省下來的等待時間會自己把價差賺回來。

第三名 ASUS Zenbook A16 是我可以毫不猶豫推薦的 Windows 機。Ryzen AI 的續航終於追得上 Apple Silicon，16 吋 OLED 很漂亮，重量壓在 1.5 公斤以內，以 16 吋機身來說是很紮實的工程成果。

關於 Windows 陣營我想補一句：Snapdragon 和 Ryzen AI 合力把「Windows 筆電帶出門很痛苦」這個問題解決了。ARM 上的軟體相容性現在好到大多數人根本不會察覺。跟兩年前比這是很明顯的轉變，也是為什麼我的前六名裡有三台 Windows。

這禮拜不動。秋季改款潮九月才開始。

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 贏在安靜和續航，不是贏在跑分
highlights.body: 混合使用實測十八小時，零風扇噪音，因為它根本沒有風扇。M5 跑 Lightroom 圖庫和 Xcode 編譯，從來不會跳出過熱警告。對絕大多數買筆電的人來說，這三件事每天都在影響體驗，跑分數字你這輩子大概只會看一次。這就是它守住第一的原因，我預期它撐得過整個秋天。

highlights.title: 工作任務跑很久，就買 MacBook Pro 14
highlights.body: 被動散熱有硬天花板，Air 在真正長的編譯和影片輸出上會撞到。MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro 有風扇，一小時的 ProRes 輸出可以全程滿速，不會跑到二十分鐘就開始降頻。判斷很簡單：短爆發的工作選 Air，長時間的工作選 Pro，價差會用你省下的等待時間還回來。

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 是我推 Windows 機不用加但書的那台
highlights.body: 16 吋 OLED 面板、Ryzen AI 撐一整天的續航、整機不到 1.5 公斤。把 16 吋機身做到這麼輕，同時鍵盤面還不軟，這是真功夫，華碩做到了。如果你要大螢幕看試算表或剪片，但每天還是得帶上捷運，這台一次解決兩個問題。

highlights.title: Windows 總算把續航問題修好了
highlights.body: Snapdragon X 和 Ryzen AI 聯手把 Windows 筆電「帶出門很麻煩」的續航差距補上了。ARM 上的軟體相容性也到了大多數人好幾個月都碰不到一個跑不動的程式。這個轉變就是為什麼我今年前六名塞了三台 Windows，這種榜單在 2024 年是寫不出來的。

en.commentary: August 25 is the date that matters for this category, because that is when the deepest back to school discounts end and prices return to normal until Black Friday. If you need a laptop this year, the next ten days are the best window you will get, and my advice is to buy the machine you want at a discount rather than a better machine at full price. The MacBook Air 13 M5 holds first at 9.2 and it is the recommendation I make most often, because it is the only laptop here that is silent, lasts a genuine full working day on battery, and still handles everything a student or knowledge worker throws at it. Fanless design is an underrated feature. A machine that never spins up is a machine you can use in a quiet library or a shared apartment without irritating anyone, including yourself. The MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro at 9.0 is the correct step up for sustained heavy work, since the active cooling lets it hold performance through a long compile or export where the Air throttles. ASUS Zenbook A16 third at 8.9 is the best Windows option for anyone who needs x86 compatibility with strong battery life. Dell XPS 14 2026 fourth at 8.8. For Taiwanese buyers, my practical note is to check the keyboard layout and the warranty terms locally, since international models bought during a sale sometimes carry service conditions that cost more than the discount saved. No rank or score changes today.

highlights.title: The discount window closes August 25, so decide this week
highlights.body: Back to school pricing ends on August 25 and does not return until Black Friday. If you need a laptop this year, buying the machine you actually want at a discount beats buying a nominally better machine at full price. Ten days is enough time to decide properly and not enough to postpone indefinitely.

highlights.title: Fanless operation is a feature people undervalue until they have it
highlights.body: The MacBook Air M5 never spins up, which means it works in a quiet library, a shared apartment, or a late night beside a sleeping partner without irritating anyone. Silence changes where and when a laptop is usable, and no benchmark captures it. That practical quality is part of why it holds first at 9.2.

highlights.title: Step up to the Pro 14 only if your work sustains load
highlights.body: Active cooling lets the MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro hold performance through a long compile or a video export where the Air throttles. If your day involves those tasks regularly, the difference is real and worth paying for. If it does not, the extra money buys a benchmark result rather than a faster afternoon.

highlights.title: Check local warranty terms before buying an imported deal
highlights.body: International models bought during a sale sometimes carry service conditions in Taiwan that cost more to resolve than the discount saved. Confirm the local warranty coverage and repair path before ordering, because a screen replacement handled outside the official channel erases a good deal quickly.

highlights.title: 無風扇這件事，用過的人才知道自己以前低估了它

en.commentary:
The MacBook Air M5 stays at the top of my list, and the single change that locked it in place this year is storage. Apple finally starts the Air at 512GB, which removes the one recommendation caveat I had been repeating for years. Everything else about the machine was already right: fast enough for real work, silent because there is no fan, light enough that you stop noticing the bag, and a battery that genuinely clears a working day. Recent roundups reach the same conclusion for the same reasons, calling it the laptop most people should buy, with pricing around 1,099 to 1,299 dollars depending on configuration.

The interesting pressure this month comes from ASUS. Windows Central ran a direct comparison arguing the Zenbook A16 beats the Air in key areas, and I think the challenge is legitimate on screen size and price per inch. You get a large panel in a chassis that stays genuinely portable, which is a combination Apple does not offer at this price. That is why the A16 holds third here and why I would not argue with anyone who buys one.

The MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro keeps second because sustained performance is a different problem than burst performance. If you compile, render, or export video, the extra thermal headroom is what you are paying for.

The Dell XPS 14 remains the Windows flagship for people who want a beautiful display and the best battery figure on this list at 9.8, and the Zenbook S 14 OLED is still my pick when panel quality per dollar is the deciding factor. Buy for the screen and the weight, because those are the two things you touch every hour.

highlights.title: 512GB base storage removed the last caveat
highlights.body: The MacBook Air M5 now starts at 512GB, which was the one thing that used to force an upsell conversation. Fast, fanless, and a battery that clears a full working day at roughly 1,099 to 1,299 dollars.

highlights.title: The Zenbook A16 is a legitimate challenge
highlights.body: Windows Central argues directly that it beats the Air in key areas, and on screen size per dollar in a genuinely portable chassis I agree. It holds third here for good reason.

highlights.title: MacBook Pro 14 is about sustained load
highlights.body: Burst speed and sustained speed are different problems. If you compile, render, or export video daily, the M4 Pro thermal headroom is what the extra money buys.

highlights.title: XPS 14 leads on battery
highlights.body: Its 9.8 battery score is the highest in this ranking, paired with a display that still sets the standard for Windows flagships.

highlights.title: Buy for screen and weight
highlights.body: Those are the two attributes you interact with every hour of every day. Specs you notice once a month should not outrank the ones you feel constantly.

zh-tw.commentary:
MacBook Air M5 繼續坐我榜單第一，而今年真正把它鎖死在這個位置的，是儲存空間。

Apple 終於讓 Air 從 512GB 起跳，這一改，我唸了好幾年的那個「但是」就消失了。其他部分它本來就到位：跑實際工作夠快、沒有風扇所以安靜、輕到你會忘記包包裡有它、電池也真的撐得完一個工作天。最近的評測結論跟我一樣，理由也一樣，都說它是大多數人該買的那台，價格大概落在 1,099 到 1,299 美元之間，看你怎麼配。

這個月比較有意思的壓力來自 ASUS。Windows Central 直接做了對比，主張 Zenbook A16 在幾個關鍵面向贏過 Air，我覺得就螢幕尺寸跟每吋單價來說，這個挑戰是成立的。你拿到一片大螢幕，機身卻還維持在真的能帶著走的範圍，這個組合 Apple 在這個價位確實沒有。所以 A16 在這裡排第三，有人買它我不會有意見。

MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro 守住第二，因為持續效能跟瞬間效能是兩個不同的問題。如果你每天要編譯、算圖或輸出影片，多花的錢買的就是那段散熱餘裕。

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 是成立的挑戰
highlights.body: Windows Central 直接主張它在關鍵面向贏過 Air，就螢幕尺寸與每吋單價、機身又真的能帶著走這點，我同意。它排第三是有道理的。

highlights.title: XPS 14 續航領先
highlights.body: 電池分數 9.8 是這份榜單最高，螢幕也依然是 Windows 旗艦的標竿水準。

highlights.title: 挑螢幕跟重量
highlights.body: 這兩項是你每天每小時都在接觸的東西。一個月才注意一次的規格，不該壓過你天天有感的那兩項。

references.title: Apple raises base price of MacBook Air and MacBook Pro, but RAM upgrade costs remain unchanged
Apple Holds an Edge as Laptop Prices Could Face a 40% Increase
Laptop prices could soar by at least 20% in 2026, not just due to higher DRAM costs

en.commentary:
I want to give the clearest possible answer to the question I get most often right now, which is whether to buy a laptop today or wait for prices to come down. Buy today. Memory and storage now account for roughly 35 percent of a laptop's bill of materials, up from 15 to 18 percent a quarter earlier, because AI data centre demand absorbed the production capacity that used to feed consumer devices. TrendForce projects mainstream laptop prices rising by close to 40 percent across 2026. Dell moved 15 to 20 percent from mid-December, Lenovo followed in January, and HP, Acer and Asus have all warned on contract resets.

That context is why the MacBook Air M5 stays first. Apple raised the Air and the Pro by 200 to 300 dollars and left RAM upgrade pricing untouched, which means the step from base to 24GB costs the same today as it did last year while every Windows maker is repricing that exact upgrade. Apple's long-term memory contracts bought it a timing advantage, and that advantage shows up directly in what you pay for a well-specified machine.

My configuration advice has changed because of this. Buy the memory you need at purchase and do not plan to upgrade later, since the soldered-memory reality of thin laptops was already true and the cost of getting it wrong just went up sharply.

The Asus Zenbook A16 at third is the Windows machine I recommend without reservation. It delivers a genuine all-day battery and a 16-inch OLED panel at a price that has held better than most of its competition through the repricing wave.

highlights.title: Buy now, waiting costs money in this market
highlights.body: Memory and storage jumped to roughly 35 percent of a laptop's bill of materials from 15 to 18 percent a quarter earlier, and TrendForce projects mainstream prices climbing close to 40 percent across 2026. Dell repriced 15 to 20 percent in December, Lenovo in January. Every month of waiting in this cycle is a month of paying more for the same machine.

highlights.title: The MacBook Air M5 stays first because Apple's RAM upgrade pricing held
highlights.body: Apple raised base prices 200 to 300 dollars and left memory upgrade costs unchanged, so stepping up to 24GB costs what it did last year. Every Windows manufacturer is repricing that same upgrade right now. On a well-specified machine rather than a base config, that difference is what keeps the Air at 9.3.

highlights.title: Buy the memory you need on day one
highlights.body: Thin laptops have soldered memory, so the configuration you buy is the configuration you keep. That was always true, and the cost of getting it wrong has risen sharply. Spend the extra now on 24GB or 32GB if there is any chance you will need it, because replacing the whole machine in two years will cost far more than the upgrade does today.

highlights.title: Asus Zenbook A16 is the Windows pick that held its price best
highlights.body: A 16-inch OLED panel with genuine all-day battery life, and pricing that has moved less than most of its competition through the memory repricing wave. For anyone who needs Windows, this is the machine I recommend without qualification, and its 8.9 reflects a package that stayed sensible while the category got expensive.

en.commentary:
The MacBook Air 13-inch with M5 stays at number one and the list is unchanged this week, but the budget end of the market is getting genuinely interesting. Dell's new XPS 13 landed at 699 dollars, or 599 for students, in a 2.2 pound chassis that is 12.7 millimeters thick, with a 13.4-inch 2.5K 120Hz display rated at 500 nits and full DCI-P3 coverage. Reviewers this month have been putting it directly against the MacBook Neo, and the display spec is the part that stands out: a 120Hz panel at that price is something the entry tier simply did not have a year ago.

The catch is the base configuration. Eight gigabytes of RAM with a 512 gigabyte SSD is thin for a machine people keep for four or five years, and with DRAM prices where they are in 2026, the upgrade is not cheap. I would treat the 699 dollar model as the floor and budget for the step up.

That context is exactly why the MacBook Neo holds ninth place on a 9.9 value score. It is the machine I recommend for browser work, documents and video calls, where unified memory and a 9.0 battery score matter more than raw compute.

At the top, nothing has changed my ordering. Take the M5 Air for the best balance, the 14-inch M4 Pro if you export video, and the Zenbook A16 if you want a large screen without the weight penalty.

highlights.body: The base XPS 13 ships with 8GB and a 512GB SSD, which is thin for a four-year machine given where DRAM prices sit in 2026.

references.title: Nvidia unveils RTX Spark Superchip for laptops and desktop PCs at Computex 2026
Nvidia lays out RTX Spark roadmap for laptops and desktop PCs

en.commentary:
There is a real reason to think carefully about timing right now. Nvidia's RTX Spark platform, a 20-core Arm CPU paired with a Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory, is due in laptops this fall from Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft Surface and MSI. As of late August, Nvidia has not published pricing or opened pre-orders. That is a genuinely new architecture arriving in Windows laptops, and if you are the sort of buyer who keeps a machine for five years, it is worth knowing that it is close.

That said, the MacBook Air M5 stays first at 9.3 and I would still buy it today without hesitation. It is silent, it runs all day on battery, it has the best trackpad and one of the best displays in its class, and it does every task most people actually perform without ever spinning up. RTX Spark is aimed at a different problem, which is local AI workloads and gaming on Windows. It does not make a fanless ultraportable obsolete.

The MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro at 9.0 is the pick when you compile, render or edit video and want sustained performance instead of burst. The Zenbook A16 at 8.9 is the strongest Windows recommendation on this list and remains excellent value. If you need a machine this week, buy one of these three. If your current laptop has six months left in it, watch what lands in October before committing.

highlights.title: RTX Spark laptops arrive this fall and pricing is still unannounced
highlights.body: Nvidia's platform pairs a 20-core Arm CPU with a Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB unified memory, shipping from six major vendors this fall. No pre-orders and no published pricing as of late August. If your current machine has six months of life left, that is a genuine reason to wait and see what October brings.

highlights.title: The MacBook Air M5 stays first and would still be my purchase today
highlights.body: Silent operation, all-day battery, the best trackpad in the industry, and enough performance that most people never hear it work. At 9.3 it does the job the overwhelming majority of laptop buyers actually have, and a new Windows architecture aimed at local AI does not change that calculation.

highlights.title: Buy the MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro when you need sustained load, not burst
highlights.body: Compiling, rendering and video editing punish machines that are fast for thirty seconds and then throttle. The M4 Pro holds its clocks under sustained work and the cooling supports it. At 9.0 it is the right upgrade over the Air only if your workload actually looks like that.

highlights.title: The Zenbook A16 is the Windows pick that makes financial sense
highlights.body: At 8.9 it is the strongest Windows recommendation here on value, and it is available now with known pricing, which the fall RTX Spark machines are not. For a reader who needs Windows and needs a laptop this month, this is where I would put the money.

zh-tw.commentary:

Nvidia 的 RTX Spark 平台，20 核 Arm CPU 配 Blackwell GPU、最高 128GB 統一記憶體，預定今年秋天由華碩、Dell、HP、聯想、微軟 Surface、微星一起推出。到八月底為止，Nvidia 還沒公布價格也還沒開預購。這是一個真正的新架構要進到 Windows 筆電裡，如果你是那種一台用五年的人，知道它快來了是有意義的。

話說回來，MacBook Air M5 守住第一 9.3 分，我今天還是會毫不猶豫買它。完全靜音、電池撐一整天、觸控板業界最好、螢幕在同級裡數一數二，而且大多數人真正會做的事情它跑起來風扇根本不會轉。RTX Spark 瞄準的是另一個問題，本地 AI 運算跟 Windows 遊戲，它不會讓一台無風扇輕薄筆電變成過時產品。

MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro 拿 9.0，適合會編譯、算圖、剪影片，需要的是持續效能而不是瞬間爆發的人。Zenbook A16 8.9 分，是這張榜上最值得推薦的 Windows 機，性價比一直很好。

這週就要用的話，這三台選一台。手上那台還撐得住半年的話，先看十月會出什麼再說。

highlights.title: RTX Spark 筆電秋天到，價格到現在還沒公布
highlights.body: Nvidia 這個平台是 20 核 Arm CPU 配 Blackwell GPU、最高 128GB 統一記憶體，秋天由六家大廠一起出貨。八月底為止沒有預購、沒有官方定價。如果你現在這台還能再撐半年，那這確實是一個值得等等看十月的理由。

highlights.title: MacBook Air M5 守住第一，今天要買我還是買它
highlights.body: 全程靜音、電池撐一整天、觸控板業界最好，效能足到大多數人根本不會聽見它在工作。9.3 分，它解決的是絕大多數筆電買家真正面對的問題，而一個瞄準本地 AI 的新 Windows 架構，不會改變這個算式。

highlights.title: 需要持續負載而不是瞬間爆發，才買 MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro
highlights.body: 編譯、算圖、剪片會狠狠懲罰那種前三十秒很快、然後開始降頻的機器。M4 Pro 在長時間負載下守得住時脈，散熱也撐得起來。9.0 分，只有你的工作真的長這樣，它才值得從 Air 升上去。

highlights.title: Zenbook A16 是財務上說得過去的 Windows 選擇
highlights.body: 8.9 分，這張榜上性價比最強的 Windows 機，而且現在買得到、價格是已知的，秋天那批 RTX Spark 機器兩樣都沒有。如果你需要 Windows 而且這個月就要用，錢我會放在這裡。

references.title: IFA 2026: Here's what to expect from the tech show
IFA Berlin 2026 - Innovation For All

en.commentary: The MacBook Air 13 with M5 holds first because it is the laptop that gets the whole package right for the largest number of people. Performance that handles everything short of sustained professional rendering, battery that genuinely lasts a working day, a display that is excellent rather than merely adequate, and a fanless design that stays silent. Most buyers do not need more than this, and buying more than this means carrying weight you will resent. The MacBook Pro 14 with M4 Pro at second is the machine for people who actually do sustained heavy work, where the thermal headroom translates into finished renders rather than throttled ones. The Zenbook A16 at third is the best Windows option on battery life and portability. The XPS 14 at fourth is the premium Windows build, and the Blade 16 at fifth covers people who need discrete graphics in a laptop. IFA opens September 4 with AMD keynoting and the Ryzen AI MAX 400 series expected, and Acer runs its own AI PC event on September 2. Windows buyers specifically should wait two weeks. Mac buyers have no reason to. The ranking holds today.

highlights.title: Most people need less laptop than they buy
highlights.body: The M5 Air handles everything short of sustained professional rendering while staying silent and lasting a working day. Buying beyond that means carrying weight and paying for headroom you will not use.

highlights.title: Windows buyers should wait two weeks
highlights.body: AMD keynotes IFA on September 4 with the Ryzen AI MAX 400 series expected, and Acer runs an AI PC event on September 2. New silicon and new machines are days away, so a purchase now risks immediate obsolescence.

highlights.title: Thermal headroom is what the Pro actually buys you
highlights.body: For sustained heavy work, the difference shows up as finished renders rather than throttled ones. If your workload runs for minutes rather than seconds, that headroom is the specific thing worth the price difference.

zh-tw.commentary:
MacBook Air 13 吋 M5 排第一，因為它是對最多人來說整體最對的一台。效能足以應付除了長時間專業算圖以外的所有事情、續航是真的撐得過一個工作天、螢幕不只是堪用而是優秀、無風扇設計全程安靜。

大多數人不需要比這更多，而買超過這個規格，代表你每天要多背你會後悔的重量。台灣通勤族背包裡的東西已經夠多了。

MacBook Pro 14 吋 M4 Pro 第二名，給那些真的在做長時間重度工作的人，散熱餘裕會直接轉換成「算完的成品」而不是「被降頻的成品」。

Zenbook A16 第三名是 Windows 陣營續航跟攜帶性最好的。XPS 14 第四名是高階 Windows 做工，Blade 16 第五名給需要獨立顯卡的人。

IFA 九月四號開展，AMD 做開幕演講，預期發表 Ryzen AI MAX 400 系列，Acer 九月二號也有自己的 AI PC 活動。想買 Windows 機的人請等兩週。想買 Mac 的沒有等的理由。今天排序維持。

highlights.title: 大多數人買的筆電都超過自己需要的
highlights.body: M5 Air 能處理除了長時間專業算圖以外的所有事，全程安靜又撐得過一個工作天。買超過這個規格，等於天天背著你用不到的餘裕。

highlights.title: 要買 Windows 機的請等兩週
highlights.body: AMD 九月四號在 IFA 做開幕演講，預期發表 Ryzen AI MAX 400 系列，Acer 九月二號也有 AI PC 活動。新平台就在幾天後，現在買有立刻過時的風險。

highlights.title: Pro 真正賣給你的是散熱餘裕
highlights.body: 長時間重度工作的情況下，差別會顯示為「算完的成品」跟「被降頻的成品」。如果你的工作負載是以分鐘計而不是以秒計，這份餘裕就是價差買到的東西。

references.title: RAM price tracking 2026 — lowest price on DDR5 and DDR4 memory
IFA 2026: Here's what to expect from the tech show
Apple September event 2026: iPhone 18, new Apple Watches, AirPods and more expected

en.commentary: The memory market is the story that should drive your laptop purchase right now. DDR5 has roughly doubled year over year, a 32GB DDR5-6000 kit now sits around $400 to $440, and NAND contract prices rose 55 to 60 percent quarter over quarter earlier this year. TrendForce expects the climb to continue through Q3 and Q4, and one major manufacturer has presold its entire 2026 NAND output. For laptop buyers this has a very specific consequence: configure the memory and storage you will need for the life of the machine at purchase, because upgrading later will cost far more than it does today, and most thin laptops solder the RAM anyway. The MacBook Air with M5 holds first at 9.3 for exactly this reason among others. Apple's unified memory pricing was set before the current spike, and the base configuration remains genuinely usable. Battery life past fifteen hours and silent fanless operation still have no real answer in the Windows field. The MacBook Pro 14-inch with M4 Pro at 9.0 stays the pick for sustained compilation and video work. IFA opens in Berlin on September 4 with press days on the 2nd and 3rd, and Acer has confirmed a Next @ Acer event on September 2 promising AI PCs and new display technology. If you want a Windows laptop, waiting a week gets you the full autumn field.

highlights.title: Buy the RAM and storage you need now, because upgrades get worse from here
highlights.body: DDR5 has roughly doubled year over year and NAND contract prices rose 55 to 60 percent in a single quarter. TrendForce expects further increases through Q4. Most thin laptops solder their memory anyway, so the configuration you choose at checkout is the configuration you live with. Size up one tier while it is still affordable.

highlights.title: The MacBook Air with M5 wins partly because its pricing predates the spike
highlights.body: Apple set unified memory pricing before the current DRAM squeeze, and the base configuration is genuinely usable for real work. Add fifteen-hour battery life and completely silent operation, and 9.3 with first place is easy to defend. This is the laptop I recommend to most people without qualification.

highlights.title: Wait until September 4 if you want a Windows machine
highlights.body: IFA press days fall on September 2 and 3, and Acer has confirmed a Next @ Acer event on the 2nd covering AI PCs and next-generation displays. The autumn Windows field will be visible within a week. The Zenbook A16 at 8.9 and XPS 14 at 8.8 are both strong today, and a few days gives you the complete picture.

highlights.title: The MacBook Pro 14-inch with M4 Pro earns its premium on sustained load
highlights.body: At 9.0 it holds full clocks through long compiles and video exports where thinner machines throttle. If your work involves hours of continuous heavy load, that consistency is what you are paying for. For everything lighter, the Air delivers the same experience and saves you a considerable amount.

zh-tw.commentary:
現在買筆電，真正該主導你決策的是記憶體市場。DDR5 年增大約翻倍，一組 32GB DDR5-6000 現在要價大約台幣一萬三到一萬四，NAND 合約價今年稍早更是單季上漲五成五到六成。TrendForce 預期第三季、第四季還會繼續往上，而且已經有大廠把 2026 年整年的 NAND 產能全部預售出去。

這對買筆電的人有一個非常具體的結論：一次把你這台機器整個使用週期會需要的記憶體跟儲存空間配好。之後再升級的代價會比現在高很多，而且薄型筆電本來記憶體多半就是焊死的。

M5 版 MacBook Air 以 9.3 守住第一，這也是理由之一。Apple 的統一記憶體定價是在這波飆漲之前就訂好的，基本款配置到現在都還是真的夠用。超過十五小時的續航加上完全無風扇的安靜運作，Windows 陣營目前也還拿不出對應的答案。

9.0 分的 14 吋 M4 Pro MacBook Pro，仍然是長時間編譯跟影片工作的選擇。

IFA 九月四號在柏林開展，媒體日是二號跟三號，Acer 也確認九月二號舉辦 Next @ Acer，主打 AI PC 跟新一代顯示技術。想買 Windows 筆電的話，等一週就能看到完整的秋季陣容。

highlights.title: 記憶體跟儲存空間一次配到位，之後升級只會更貴
highlights.body: DDR5 年增大約翻倍，NAND 合約價單季上漲五成五到六成，TrendForce 預期第四季前還會續漲。薄型筆電的記憶體多半是焊死的，你結帳當下選的配置，就是你要用到底的配置。趁現在還負擔得起，直接往上加一階。

highlights.title: M5 版 MacBook Air 獲勝，有一部分是因為它的定價早於這波飆漲
highlights.body: Apple 的統一記憶體定價是在這輪 DRAM 緊縮之前就訂好的，基本款配置拿來做實際工作是真的夠用。再加上十五小時續航跟完全無聲的運作，9.3 分拿第一很好辯護。這是我會毫無保留推薦給大多數人的筆電。

highlights.title: 想買 Windows 機器，先等到九月四號
highlights.body: IFA 媒體日落在九月二號跟三號，Acer 確認二號舉辦 Next @ Acer，主題涵蓋 AI PC 跟次世代顯示技術。整個秋季 Windows 陣容一週內就會攤在你面前。8.9 分的 Zenbook A16 跟 8.8 分的 XPS 14 今天都很強，多等幾天就能看到完整版圖。

highlights.title: 14 吋 M4 Pro MacBook Pro 的溢價，賺在長時間高負載
highlights.body: 9.0 分，它能在長時間編譯跟影片輸出中維持滿頻，而更薄的機器這時候已經降頻了。如果你的工作是連續好幾小時的重負載，你付的錢買的就是這份穩定。其餘更輕的用途，Air 提供一樣的體驗，還幫你省下一大筆。
